title: Certified Bounds on the Measurement Cost of Molecular Hamiltonians
summary: Quantum estimates of molecular energy require repeated state preparation and measurement. We bound the minimum repetition count for given measurements and processing rules from above with a practical schedule and from below with independently verified inequalities. For an H$_4$ chain at H-H distances of 0.90 and 1.80 Åwith 2 per cent uniform noise in the ground state, entangling Clifford measurements, which map Pauli products onto one another, cut leading-order repetitions by at least 65.9 and 61.0 per cent, respectively, relative to any schedule using only single-qubit Pauli measurements…
